name: Ziguinchor
registryCustodian: Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines (DGID), local Centre des services fiscaux (CSF) Ziguinchor
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and French discovery evidenced the DGID/CSF local cadastral custodian and the official ONDDL SIG portal. Current ONDDL configuration and WFS capabilities were inspected. The catalog exposed administrative/GADM layers only; a bounded EPSG:4326 WFS request returned one Ziguinchor administrative point, while parcel-layer guesses returned unknown-feature-type errors. No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was verified.
scopeLimits: DGID and CSF evidence establishes custody/procedure, not open parcel geometry.
ONDDL SIG catalog and WFS capabilities are a bounded view of currently published public resources; unpublished, authenticated, or separate DGID systems may exist.
The administrative point near the WUP point is not a parcel hit and no citywide absence was inferred.
Exact WUP point [12.5660118868597, -16.2721765081404] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
No sample GeoJSON was retained because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
sourceSpecificFields: The verified ONDDL WFS administrative response used fid/id/name/reg/dept/cod_dept/code_reg and EPSG:4326 geometry; these are not parcel fields and were not retained as a sample.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; serial review must independently verify any DGID/CSF or ONDDL parcel adapter, safe field mapping, native identity stability, CRS, coverage, and current access behavior.
uncertainty: Local cadastral custody is supported by first-party DGID evidence, but no anonymous parcel dataset, schema, citywide coverage, update cadence, or safe geometry endpoint was verified. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or owner/address/tax data were used or requested.
